title: Catch-Up Prompt-Payment Discount Lines on the Commercial Credit Account
content:
A payment received inside the discount window of the invoice it is applied to earns the prompt-payment discount set out in this rule, and Corbett books that discount as a catch-up discount line when the account's most recent payment earned it and the invoice that payment is applied to carries no discount line.

### What the catch-up line does

A catch-up discount line is a credit on the Commercial Credit Account: it is recorded against the invoice the most recent payment is applied to, it carries the discount amount, that invoice, the reference of the payment that earned it and that payment's received date, and it lowers the account's open receivable balance by the discount amount. The customer sees the discount as a credit on the invoice and a lower balance owed.

| Records show | Catch-up line |
|---|---|
| the most recent payment earned a prompt-payment discount, and its invoice carries no discount line | booked on that invoice |
| that invoice already carries a discount line | not booked |

### Booking the line: `book_cash_discount_2280b564`

The line is booked with the agent-side tool `book_cash_discount_2280b564`: the agent unlocks it and then calls it. One call records one discount line against the named invoice.

**Parameters**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `credit_account_id` | the reference number of the customer's Commercial Credit Account the discount is booked on, read from the credit account lookup | identifier |
| `applied_invoice_number` | the invoice number the discount is applied to | copied exactly as it appears on that invoice in the account's receivable history, keeping its prefix, digits and punctuation unchanged |
| `payment_reference` | the reference of the customer payment that earned the discount | copied exactly as it appears on that payment in the account's receivable history, every character unchanged |
| `payment_date` | the date the earning payment was received, as recorded on that payment | YYYY-MM-DD, calendar date with no time part |
| `discount_amount` | the cash discount credited on the invoice | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, rounded half up to the cent |

**Return.** A text rendering of a dictionary with: `status` — the word booked when the discount line is recorded; `discount_reference` — the reference of the new discount line (text, prefix CD-); `applied_invoice_number` — the invoice the discount is applied to; `discount_amount` — the amount credited in USD with 2 decimal places; `ar_balance` — the account's open receivable balance with the discount credited, in USD with 2 decimal places (negative means a credit balance).

### Questions on the tool contract

**Does the tool check whether the discount was earned?** No. It records the line it is given; whether a discount was earned, and how much, is decided from the account's records under the cash discount rules.

**What does the receipt's balance show?** The account's open receivable balance after the discount amount is credited.
